description: This file contains tests for various functions related to processing and parsing Telegram targets, including prefix stripping, target parsing, normalization, and policy resolution. It utilizes the 'vitest' testing framework to verify behavior of functions handling Telegram-specific identifiers and policies.

methods.name: stripTelegramInternalPrefixes
methods.description: Removes internal Telegram prefixes from target strings to extract the core identifier.

methods.name: parseTelegramTarget
methods.description: Parses a Telegram target string into an object containing chatId, messageThreadId, and chatType.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramChatId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of Telegram chat IDs, rejecting non-numeric and URL forms.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramLookupTarget
methods.description: Normalizes legacy and username forms of Telegram lookup targets into a standard format.

methods.name: isNumericTelegramChatId
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid numeric Telegram chat ID.

methods.name: resolveTelegramGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Resolves whether a Telegram group requires mention based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveTelegramGroupToolPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the tool policy allowed for a Telegram group based on configuration.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramAllowFromEntry
methods.description: Normalizes entries for 'allow from' configuration, handling tg/telegram prefixes.

methods.name: looksLikeTelegramTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a Telegram target identifier.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramMessagingTarget
methods.description: Normalizes various Telegram messaging target formats into a standard format.

methods.name: installMaybePersistResolvedTelegramTargetTests
methods.description: Invokes the registration of shared tests related to persistent targets.
